blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP) has urged Filipino Catholics to pray for Pope Leo XIV as he prepares to undergo lung surgery. In a statement issued on Monday, CBCP president and Lipa Archbishop Gilbert Garcera urged bishops and priests to offer Masses for the pope’s successful surgery and full recovery. “Let us pray that the Lord may guide his surgeons and all who care for him, sustain him with strength and peace, and restore him to health as he continues to shepherd the universal Church,” Garcera said.
